nodes.label: Dynamic Backend Routing
nodes.rationale: Supports both frontend static routing and backend dynamic routing for flexible permission-based menu control.

nodes.label: Theme Presets System
nodes.rationale: Supports theme preset functions allowing partial content settings and override of component library presets for flexible UI customization.

nodes.label: @sa/axios Package
nodes.rationale: Internal monorepo package for HTTP request handling, replacing CancelTokenSource with AbortController, supporting flatRequest with response on success.

nodes.label: @sa/hooks Package
nodes.rationale: Internal monorepo package providing Vue composables like useTable, useEcharts, useHookTable with pagination and chart rendering support.

nodes.label: @sa/scripts Package
nodes.rationale: Internal monorepo package for CLI tooling: git commit, git commit verify, and release scripts.

nodes.label: useTable Composable
nodes.rationale: Core table hook providing pagination, data fetching, column visibility, and expand display. Refactored in v2.0.0 with enhanced type definitions.

nodes.label: Token Refresh Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Handles token refresh when encountering multiple concurrent requests, fixed in v1.3.5 to avoid race conditions.

nodes.label: Layout Mode System
nodes.rationale: Supports multiple layout modes including vertical, horizontal-mix, vertical-hybrid-header-first. Optimized in v2.0.0 by splitting horizontal mix into two layouts.

nodes.label: FastSoyAdmin Ecosystem Project
nodes.rationale: A modern management platform based on FastAPI+Vue3+Naive UI, listed as part of SoybeanAdmin ecosystem.
